selection: Eight locked never-matrix-exposed public identities selected before gold access. Each shared trajectory pauses before accepting its first terminal candidate and forks to one control review and one slate review.
treatment: Exactly one terminal-only review call with one receipt-bound evidence slate at most 4,096 bytes and 1,024 provider-measured tokens. Control receives the identical review without the slate.

branch_order.method: alternating control-first and slate-first by locked task order

stopping_rules: Every scheduled identity remains in the fixed denominator.
Any ancestry, sole-prompt-difference, one-call, exposure, or 3,072-token paired-bound violation pauses before the next task.
claim_ceiling: Fresh GLM-5.3-flash 8K development canary only; not benchmark clearance
